content.body:
Starting a GLP-1 can feel exciting… until you realize you’re not totally sure what to eat, how to workout, or how to manage side effects.  

Everything I wish someone had handed me on day one of my GLP-1 journey — so you lose the weight, keep your muscle, and actually keep it off.

Here's the truth no one tells you when you start Semaglutide or Tirzepatide: the medication handles your appetite, but it doesn't teach your body what to do with the weight loss. Eat too little, skip your protein, skim past strength training — and you'll lose muscle, stall out, and watch it creep back the moment you taper off.

I know because I lived it. A year and a half on branded and compounded GLP-1s, 40 pounds down, goal weight reached — and maintained after getting off the meds. I'm also a certified personal trainer and nutrition coach, so this isn't guesswork. It's what worked, stripped of the fluff.

What's inside:

A simple framework for finding your right calorie deficit (hint: 800–1,200 is sabotaging you) so you lose fat without wrecking your metabolism

The 6-small-meals method built specifically for slowed gastric emptying — so you stay full, hit your protein, and stop skipping meals

A full sample 2,000-calorie meal plan with every macro mapped out, plus a bonus 1,600-calorie plan

Side-effect survival guides for nausea, constipation, and heartburn — real tactics, not "drink water and hope"
"When you can't eat, drink it" — my high-calorie protein shake and low-appetite rescue list for the days nothing sounds good

A beginner-friendly at-home workout (dumbbells or bodyweight) with follow-along videos to protect the muscle that keeps your metabolism high
Printable weekly meal planner, symptom tracker, and workout logs to keep you consistent

What it does for you:

This is the difference between losing weight on a medication and transforming your body for good. You'll learn to fuel — not starve — so you arrive at your goal weight leaner, stronger, and with the habits that hold once the medication is done. No deprivation. No food guilt. 

Just a real plan from someone who's been exactly where you are. 

Who it's for: Anyone starting, considering, or already on GLP1s who's serious about doing it the right way.

For less than the cost of one protein-powder run — $9 — you get the entire blueprint, instantly.

Coach Joanne is a Certified Personal Trainer and Nutrition Coach with 9+ years helping women build strength and sustainable habits — no crash diets, no punishment.
